messages:
jamie_cs: FYI kicking off Seacliff day0 onboarding thread. Primary ask from customer: full object-level audit evidence and stable egress IPs for Splunk ingestion before renewal review in 12 days. We need owners for: egress plan, KMS key policy + rotation, CloudTrail delivery confirmation, and a one-page ops runbook. @ravi_net @nora_security @elaine can you take?

ravi_net: I can own the egress plan + terraform PR. couple questions: do they accept VPC endpoints for S3 and Kinesis? and are they willing to use our managed egress IP pool or do they need static /32s?

jamie_cs: they prefer our managed pool if we can guarantee the set of IPs. they also asked about minimizing internet exposure; VPC endpoints preferred.

nora_security: I'll handle KMS & CloudTrail validation. Need the existing CMK ARN or we can create a new customer-managed CMK. Plan: enable automatic rotation, attach a narrowed key policy, and create role arn:aws:iam::SEACLIFF:role/CloudTrailDelivery for PutObject with kms:Encrypt permissions. Also will check their S3 bucket policy for LogDelivery permission.

ravi_net: short firewall checklist (for the runbook):
```
- prefer S3 gateway endpoint for audit delivery
- allow outbound 443 to splunk-hec.seacliff.com via NAT pool (if endpoint not possible)
- lock egress to ALB and NAT subnets only
- document egress IPs and update WAF/ip-whitelist
```
I'll draft Terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_gateway" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
}
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "egress" {
  # managed by infra team, reference only
}
```

elaine: I'll take the runbook + customer walkthrough. proposing a 25m session Wed 09:00 PT. Walkthrough will show: validating CloudTrail objects in S3, verifying SSE-KMS encryption, and how to confirm Splunk receipt. I'll also capture any security questions for the renewal brief.

nora_security: example KMS key policy (concept):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowCloudTrailToUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::SEACLIFF:role/CloudTrailDelivery"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "DenyOutsideAccounts",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"aws:PrincipalAccount": "210987654321"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
I'll finalize a locked-down variant and post as a Gist.

ravi_net: ETA: Terraform PR with VPC endpoint + NAT egress IPs by EOD. current temporary egress candidates: 52.11.22.33/32, 3.14.159.26/32. I'll confirm allocation in PR description.

elainE: invite sent to Seacliff security ops and platform. Will attach a one-pager and a checklist:
- confirm CloudTrail objects are present in s3://seacliff-audit-logs/2026/03/
- verify object headers for x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
- check CloudTrail console shows Delivery status: Success

jamie_cs: renewal risk note: finance wants clear artifact (s3 object listing + Splunk ingestion confirmation) uploaded to account file cabinet within 10 business days. Goal: reduce risk flag.

infra-bot: CI: terraform-ops/egress-pool PR #501 created by @ravi_net  review requested.

nora_security: quick verification commands I'll run and include in runbook:
```bash
# list recent CloudTrail objects
aws s3 ls s3://seacliff-audit-logs/ --recursive | tail -n 20
# check SSE headers
aws s3api head-object --bucket seacliff-audit-logs --key 2026/03/14/CloudTrail-20260314T12Z.json
# verify CloudTrail status
aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name seacliff-trail
```
If any of these fail we'll file a blocker.

ravi_net: noted. once PR is merged i'll post the final egress IPs and update the runbook with terraform outputs.

elainE: confirmed Wed 09:00 PT works for Seacliff. I'll collect feedback and post meeting notes here.

jamie_cs: owners recap: @ravi_net = egress + terraform PR, @nora_security = KMS policy + CloudTrail verification, @elaine = runbook + walkthrough + evidence capture. Target: evidence uploaded in 10 business days. Please flag blockers asap. :white_check_mark:
